items.prompt:
Create a candid street-style portrait of a beautiful breathtakingly woman with long soft brown waves, wearing an oversized deep-red cable-knit sweater layered over a blue striped collared shirt, a black mini skirt, white crew socks, and glossy black Mary Jane shoes.
She stands playfully on a quiet residential street, leaning slightly to one side with one leg extended diagonally, holding a structured caramel-brown handbag in front of her while tilting her head with a sweet playful smile.
Soft natural makeup, luminous semi-matte skin, rosy blush, subtle brown eyeliner, fluttery lashes, and glossy rose-pink lips.
Charming Korean neighborhood atmosphere, stone wall and wooden gate behind her, soft overcast daylight, natural colors, photorealistic, 35mm film, subtle grain. --ar 9:16 --style raw
